in_marathi.name: Ganpati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Ganas
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganpati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The elephant-headed god, Ganesha, is the Remover of Obstacles and the Lord of Beginnings. He is revered as the god of wisdom and knowledge, and the god of good fortune and prosperity.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Ganas
